score: Original synthesized ambient score for RELIC, ducked beneath genuine historical recordings. Sound is off by default and enabled by user gesture. No historical voice is synthesized.
scientificContext: Ancient universe, disk, young-Earth and molten-surface scenes are NASA scientific artist visualizations. The blue globe is a modern PACE/VIIRS data visualization, not a record of ancient oceans or life. Sputnik is a flight spare filmed in a museum in 2017. Spaceflight shots are actual recorded camera footage. Mars is a pan over authentic 2012 Curiosity photographs. Discovery is a Shuttle orbiter; New Horizons is the planetary probe launch. Active and retired equipment may both remain beyond Earth; Curiosity is not described as abandoned.

editorialTreatment.sourceRangeConvention: Asset records describe verified delivered source clips. editTimeline records the original-source ranges consumed by the final builder, including the extra outgoing dissolve handle; filmStart/End are nominal narrative boundaries. editorialTreatment.generation: No generated archive images, voice cloning, AI frame enhancement or AI motion interpolation.
